title: Asus RT-BE86U Dual-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router $379 + Delivery ($0 to Metro Areas/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com
body:
Deal: Asus RT-BE86U Dual-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router $379 + Delivery ($0 to Metro Areas/ C&C/ in-Store) @ Centre Com

[willy000] Also $379 at Computer Alliance and Scorptec
https://www.computeralliance.com.au/asus-rt-be86u-dual-band-…
https://www.scorptec.com.au/product/networking/modems-and-ro…
Wait add MSY and PCCasegear
https://www.msy.com.au/product/asus-be6800-wifi-7-802-11be-g…
https://www.pccasegear.com/products/68393/asus-rt-be86u-wifi…
[Wilburre] RT-BE92U is $303 on Amazon and appears to be better?
[Wilburre] How so? I don't claim to know that it's better, only said it appears to be.
Larger model number for the same line, same 20G of wired bandwidth, higher maximum wireless bandwidth.
[GreenGuava] I think that one is a UK import. The UK and EU have laws limiting router signal output power which results in greatly reduced WiFi range when compared to local Australian models
[nategasm] I compared the 2 models here
tl;dr BE92U is better at short range, but worse at long range (even more so with the UK version). It also has a slower CPU. Though it now being cheaper certainly makes it a bit more attractive.
[Wilburre] Yeah it being the UK version puts a pin in it unfortunately. Thanks for the link.
[Mortin] Was $339 last month on Amazon Business
Bought one for $239 using new account discount
Using it as an mesh for my ROG GT AX6000
[GenerallyClumsy] What's the deal with Asus and dual band wifi 7. Kind of stupid.
[ozbagends] Shouldnt it be tri band at this price, especially being 1 router
[hollykryten] What about this then the ASUS RT-BE92U WiFi 7 Tri Band for $397 on sale at Bing Lee. Better model for not much more bucks. It's however on backorder but can be ordered.
https://www.binglee.com.au/products/be9700-dual-band-wifi-7-…
[jallen89] Thanks for posting. Just purchased, upgrading from an Asus AX58U.
[nategasm] It's only better if you can take full advantage of the 6ghz band, which is limited to close range with no obstacles. Otherwise the BE86U is faster at all other ranges due to its better 5ghz.
[GuniGuGu] Don't know why you got downvoted.. agree. It's a lot of money for a dual band router
[He-Mania] I didn't buy the Tri band model as this one gives 5ghz more antenna
[EitherWayUp] Honestly, Wi-Fi 7 is not worth it yet. The main feature being MLO is not even properly implemented. Watch this before considering a Wi-Fi 7 Router https://youtu.be/-5o_Qu3XToQ I wish I watched it before I bought mine because the performance of my Wi-Fi 6 Router was no different to my newer Wi-Fi 7 Tri-Band router which I bought given we now have more than 4 Wi-Fi 7 capable devices in the house… and it was on sale.
[askbargain] MLO is marketed the most because big number better. There are other benefits to Wifi 7 that are more important.
[Trishool] …. such as? You've left me on a cliff hanger!
[p3r514n] Best thing I ever did was get a WiFi 7 Mesh System. Range and speed like no other Mesh System I've ever owned. I went from Quad Band WiFi 6E to Tri-Band WiFi 7 and the difference is night and day.
[scottb721] How would someone know what technology would actually be beneficial to them, vs what others/marketing say they need to have ?
[He-Mania] Great router - upgraded form a 68U and boy it's so much better. Should have done it sooner. Wifi signal is much stronger and don't need a mesh anymore
[He-Mania] Why would I post it if it wasn't?
With the 68U I need the AiMesh for signal router to reach the furthest room. With this, no mesh and I get decent signal
